item.title: PHOTOS – McCracken Lady Mustangs 9 Caldwell County 1 (Scrimmage)
item.description: Caldwell County and McCracken County met in a preseason softball scrimmage Thursday night in Princeton. The visiting Lady Mustangs claimed a 9-1 decision. Check out some shots from the game in this gallery from Your Sports Edge.

item.title: PHOTOS – Caldwell County 13 Carlisle County 4
item.description: Caldwell County played its final preseason scrimmage on Thursday by hosting Carlisle County at the VFW Ballpark in Princeton. Your Sports Edge was there and has photos.

item.title: Caldwell Rolls Past Carlisle in Final Preseason Scrimmage
item.description: The Caldwell County Tiger baseball team finished up a 2-0 preseason slate with a 13-4 victory over Carlisle County Thursday night at the VFW Ballpark in Princeton. The Tigers banged out 18 base hits in the contest.
